glosses: A baby or infant; a very young human or animal.

examples.text: These events came to pass when he was but a babe.

Though he possess sweet babes and loving wife,
A home of peace by loyal friendships cheered,
And love them more than death or happy life,

glosses: An attractive person, especially a young woman.

examples.text: During the 1980s, its vivid streetlife became a symbol of the “consumer socialism” that distinguished Hungary from other Eastern Bloc states, but Budapesters today are rather less enamoured of Váci: dressed-to-kill babes and their sugar daddies would rather pose in malls, and teenagers can find McDonald's anywhere, leaving Váci utterly dependent on tourists for its livelihood and bustle.
Hey, babe, how's about you and me getting together?
But, Babe, you don't have to meet 'em if you don't want to.

But they don't know that your sweet loving, babe
Was here when all my friends were gone

glosses: definizione mancante; se vuoi, aggiungila tu

examples.text: Koteczku, trzeba było urodzić tego bobaska dziesięć lat temu, to byłoby łatwiej i mniej by bolało, bo dziecko wyskoczyłoby jak korek z butelki. A teraz — marudziła stara jędza — cierp ciało, skoroś chciało!
examples.translation: Koťátko, tohle mimčo se mělo rodit před deseti lety, bylo by to snazší a míň by to bolelo, poněvadž dítě by vylétlo jak špunt z láhve. Ale teď, hudrovala ta stará ježibaba, co sis halt nadrobila, to si musíš sníst!
